note: Screens are ordered in recording order: 'forbidden' must be recorded BEFORE the Cognitive Services User role exists, so prepare deploys without developerPrincipalId and the 'probe' screen's own prepare adds the role and waits. A 403, a failed probe or a WARN is part of the episode.
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-17 -l westeurope -o none

$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-17 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'deployment to rg-mglab-ai-17 failed' }

screens.name: resource
steps: Open the Foundry resource in rg-mglab-ai-17 > Overview (kind AI Services, region West Europe, endpoint masked)
Open Keys and Endpoint and show local authentication disabled
Open Diagnostic settings and show 'to-log-analytics' (Audit, RequestResponse, AllMetrics) pointing to the workspace
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu
endpoint (contains the suffix) wherever it appears

screens.name: forbidden
mask: endpoint suffix if it appears in any output line

screens.name: probe
prepare: $me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-17 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p developerPrincipalId=$me --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # Cognitive Services User role propagation
mask: endpoint suffix if it appears in any output line

screens.name: operate
prepare: Start-Sleep -Seconds 240   # metrics arrive with a delay
mask: resource name suffix in the audit lines

teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-17 -n $env:AI_ACCOUNT -l westeurope
